what: Built-in Muse blink pattern: the blink signal (weights . channels) and the rule threshold for triple-blink detection on a Muse headset, used until the person calibrates (Calibrate... learns their own pattern in about a minute).
from: 6 labelled sessions (31 min, standard / noisy / boundaries, seated and standing) of one person on a Muse 2, 2026-11-10. Only these numbers are shipped, no recordings.
why: On a Muse the reference sits on the forehead (Fpz), so blinks show up largest on TP9/TP10, not on AF7/AF8 (docs/TESTING.md D25).
